project_structure.description: Monorepo containing React frontend, .NET backend API, SQL database, and Python analytics sidecar for a financial checkbook application. This is a greenfield implementation - all source directories are currently empty.

subprojects.description: React + TypeScript frontend for transaction display and management. Uses shadcn/ui for components, TanStack Table for transaction display, and React Context for state management. Currently empty - needs implementation.
.NET Web API implementing CQRS pattern with thin controllers, command/query handlers, service layer for business logic, and repository pattern for data access. Currently empty - needs implementation.
SQL database schema with Accounts, Transactions, and AccountSecurity tables. Normalized schema with foreign keys, constraints, and strategic indexes. Currently empty - needs schema and migrations.
Python analytics sidecar for data analysis and reporting. Reads from shared database. Currently empty - needs implementation. Integration details are open questions.

target_architecture.why: Defines overall tech stack (React + TypeScript, .NET, SQL, Python), coding standards for all languages, and core functional requirements including transaction display/management, authentication, and business rules

Specifies CQRS pattern with thin controllers, command/query handlers, service layer, and repository pattern. Provides detailed examples of transaction service implementation including business rule validation (insufficient funds, date constraints)

Defines database schema with Accounts, Transactions, and AccountSecurity tables. Specifies foreign keys, constraints (amount > 0, no self-transfers), indexes for query optimization, and immutable transaction ledger design

Specifies React component organization, state management with hooks and context (AuthContext, TransactionContext), shadcn/ui component usage, TanStack Table for transaction display, and form validation patterns
